summary: Lower querySelectorAll to a native DOM selector engine while preserving static NodeList snapshot semantics.

semantics.return_value: static NodeList snapshot in tree order
semantics.identity: snapshot nodes preserve DOM node identity

caveats: A live collection is not equivalent; the returned NodeList must not grow after later mutations.
Unsupported selector syntax or dynamic selectors use runtime fallback.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § ParentNode querySelector/querySelectorAll
